quick.q: What's a fair way to use AI for an essay?
options: Getting help with ideas and feedback on your text
Letting it write the whole essay

quick.q: The AI corrected a spelling mistake. What's best?
options: Ask why it's a mistake, so you learn

quick.q: You're not sure if AI is allowed for homework. What do you do?
What does "don't write it for me" in a prompt mean?
options: You want help, but you'll write it yourself

image.q: The AI wrote a whole essay (highlighted). What's fair?
options: Not handing it in as mine – I write my own
Change one word and hand it in

image.q: You pasted your essay in the highlighted message. What are you asking for?

challenge.task: Write a prompt asking for help with a report about an animal, so that you still write it yourself.
checklist: Clearly say it shouldn't write it for you
What you want (a plan, questions, explanations)
challenge.example: I'm writing a report about bees. Don't write it for me. Suggest a plan with 4 parts and, for each part, 2 questions my text should answer.
